name: Sample RTSP Camera
description: The reference resourcizer module (Terra resourcizer framework R4): one type, camera.rtsp, turns an RTSP address into an SVI source resource. A user fills its form (address, user, password) in the controller, the node declares the instance, and the module streams the camera's RTP packets as binding frames — to a file sink to record, or to any node a grant allows. It is the source seam's first consumer until remote-view takes that place.
